sentences.en: Your poem would be more powerful if you cut the final stanza.
sentences.zh: 如果你删掉你诗的最后一节，这首诗会更有力量。

sentences.en: Write a poem with four three-line stanzas.
sentences.zh: 写一首由四个三行诗节组成的诗。

sentences.en: Write a poem with three four-line stanzas.
sentences.zh: 写一首由三个四行诗节组成的诗。

senses.zh: （诗）节,（戏剧等在某一地点的）演出期,〈美〉运动比赛的段落,局，场
